name: Issued Book
query:
SELECT
    lt.name AS "Transaction ID",
    lt.article AS "Book Name",
    lt.library_member AS "Member",
    lt.date AS "Issue Date",
    a.status AS "Status"
FROM
    `tabLibrary Transaction` lt
LEFT JOIN
    `tabArticle` a ON a.name = lt.article
WHERE
    lt.docstatus = 1
    AND a.status = 'Issued'
ORDER BY
    lt.date DESC
